description: "The Young Trail Hunters" by Samuel Woodworth Cozzens is a novel written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story chronicles the escapades of two boys, Hal Hyde and Ned Brown, as they learn about life on a stock ranch in Texas and embark on a perilous journey across the Great Plains laden with adventure and discovery.

authorInfo.bio:
Samuel Woodworth Cozzens (1834–1878) wrote The Young Trail Hunters
Or, the Wild Riders of the Plains. The Veritable Adventures of Hal Hyde and Ned Brown, on Their Journey Across the Great Plains of the South-West. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
